title: Generalized Zariski cancellation for Brieskorn--Pham varieties
summary: We establish a generalized Zariski cancellation theorem for Brieskorn--Pham varieties over the field of complex numbers. More precisely, we show that if two complex Brieskorn--Pham varieties become isomorphic after taking a product with an arbitrary separated complex scheme having a smooth point, then they are already isomorphic not merely as complex algebraic varieties but, in fact, as $\mathbf{C}^*$-varieties.
